name: task_meas_epoch
note: 1 Hz task: diff_age_check, nav_data_task $097D2A, channel mgmt $095582, nav_step, rcvr_status_build, traim $0A053A; nav_mode_drop if $9D11 = 0

name: chan_status_snapshot
note: Copies per-channel SV/mode/C-N ($CF6 + $28n) and $2760/$2764 into output staging $6347-$63FF; x 3.3111572265625 scale

name: epoch_timing_probe
note: Only when $2621 = 1: stamps level-5 epoch counters $2D6/$100 into $7042 + $B6n (up to 8 per epoch)

name: pred_alt_init
note: Boot: snapshots el mask $8FAE, $81DA, $79F7, datum $7592, local offset, position $8ED6, date $8EBA, deselect list $8F89 into $3724-$379F

name: task_pred_alt
note: Task ($8C7): copies $3724 snapshot into $C70 inputs, runs almanac_recheck_and_predict into third bank $4DCA (cleared on failure)

name: task_almanac_save
note: Task ($8C8): writes almanac_ptr (0x348 + 0x2C bytes) to the inactive EEPROM bank ($0934 + $378 x bank), checksum at bank + $374, flips $1024

name: alm_health_count
note: Decodes page-25 health into buffer+$348 (alm_health_decode), counts healthy SVs into +$36E; needs >= 15; fails if a healthy-flagged SV has record health byte != 0

name: alm_new_validate
note: Validates collected almanac ($81CA): SV id match, common toa, alm_unpack ok for each; sets +$36F week, +$370 toa<<12; rejects if identical to active

name: pos_get_llh
note: Atomic copy of datum $7592 and position $8ED6 (h, lat, lon); optional ECEF distance to a reference LLH via llh_to_ecef

name: iono_delay_update
note: Klobuchar model per SV 1-32 (0.0137/(el+0.11)-0.022, 50400, 1.617, 0.064, 5 ns night); alpha/beta from $2428/$242C; az/el from pred bank $37A0; out $22F6 + 8 x SV (s)

name: magvar_update
note: Recomputes magnetic variation $81B2 via magvar_model(h km, lat deg, lon deg, decimal year) when position moved vs $968

name: geoid_sep_update
note: geoid_height(position, datum) -> $7574 (double); used for MSL height hold ($8209, $6345)

name: utc_offset_update
note: GPS-UTC from UTC block $2624: dtLS/dtLSF, tot x 4096, WNt, WNLSF, DN, A0 2^-30, A1 2^-50, +-480 s leap window; out $26AE, $26AC, leap pending $81C6

name: pos_save_check
note: When $81EE = 2: if > 3 SVs, all PR residuals small, and moved inside a distance window from the EEPROM record, saves position (pos_save_eeprom)

name: dop_compute
note: DOP x 10 (word, $FFFF singular) from a 4x4 (or 3x3 2D) normal matrix; DOP kind from pred +$619

name: sets_3sv
note: SV-set selection, 3 SVs: one set into pred +$61A, DOP at +$622

name: sets_4ofn
note: All 4-SV combinations of the candidates, DOP each, then sets_sort_by_dop

name: sets_6ofn
note: SV-set selection for 6 candidates (combinations, sorted by DOP)

name: sets_8ofn
note: SV-set selection for 8 or more candidates (combinations, sorted by DOP)

name: sv_sets_select
note: Builds per-SV unit-vector outer products from pred records, top 9 by elevation, dispatches to sets_* by count and pred +$618

name: alm_expand
note: Expands each healthy almanac record into doubles at $116A + $88 x SV (e 2^-21, i, Omegadot, sqrtA 2^-11, A, n = sqrt(mu)/A^1.5, Omega0 - We*toa, ...)

name: pred_sort_by_el
note: Lists visible, enabled, not-deselected SVs into pred +$4, sorted by elevation; count to +$3

name: alm_sv_predict
note: Almanac Kepler solve (fmod 2pi, <= 25 iterations) per SV: ECEF, ENU, range, az, el, range rate into pred +$C0 + $24 x SV

name: search_list_build
note: Builds SV search order at pred +$29 (count +$1): mode 0 default table $0AE958, 1 table order filtered by health, 2 best sets then visible then rest

name: pred_visible_flags
note: pred +$4E + SV = healthy and el >= mask $CB4; count to pred +$2

name: alm_unpack
note: Unpacks 24-byte almanac record SV n into ints (e, toa, di, Omegadot, sqrtA, Omega0, w, M0, af0, af1); fails if sqrtA < $4E2000 (2500 m^1/2)

name: sets_sort_by_dop
note: Sorts pred sets (+$61A, 10 bytes each) by DOP word at +8

name: nav_reset
note: Clears nav state, residuals, SV positions, DOPs, velocities, covariance $369C; clock_drift $81D2 = $75C0 x 0.19029; sol LLH $8F06 = $8ED6; callers boot_search_reset, nav_mode_drop

name: mat_invert
note: n x n (3 or 4) symmetric inverse of normal matrix $984 into $369C; returns 2 if singular

name: rx_time_from_svs
note: Mean receive time over channels with a transmit time ($1148 + 4n), $657C each, week-wrap handling

name: nav_init_pos
note: First-fix seed: mean of SV ECEF positions projected to the ellipsoid (ecef_to_llh), height kept from $8F06, into $B9C

name: pr_residuals
note: Per channel: PR residual $8218 + 8n = range - c x (t_rx - t_tx) - DGPS PRC (1 ms fold when $81EE = 2); range-rate residual $8258 + 8n incl. DGPS RRC

name: sv_clock_update
note: SV clock: af0 + af1 dt + af2 dt^2 + F e sqrtA sinE - TGD (+ iono if $81C2 = 1) -> svst +$140; drift +$148; corrected tx time +$168

name: sv_range_update
note: Geometric range +$110, light time +$150, LOS unit vector +$F8, Sagnac term $8F48 + 8n, predicted PR $8298 + 8n, range rate +$F0, rx time +$160

name: sv_pos_update_all
note: Per channel: full phasor init (new eph, every 10th epoch round robin $CF4) or incremental step, then sv_pos_eph

name: pps_schedule
note: 1PPS timing: ms count $291C, sub-ms $291E, $9D29 from clock bias/drift, hw delay $81BA, cable delay $820A, offset $81C8; ticks of 9.548 MHz (31.398 m)

name: latlon_wrap
note: Wraps lon to +-pi and folds lat past the pole (flips lon by pi and negates $8F28/$8F30)

name: pos_cocom_limit
note: If height > 18288 m and speed > 514.4 m/s: clamp height 18288 m, scale velocity; height < -1000 m -> -1000 m

name: pos_smooth
note: Position complementary filter $C06 (propagate by velocity, blend LS fix with gain 1/100 or 1/500, DGPS-dependent); resets on mode, hold or $8216 = 0

name: vel_smooth
note: Velocity smoothing with HDOP/VDOP-dependent gain (tables $0AE9E2/$0AEA0A by $8EB8); speed $8F40

name: nav_cold_fix
note: Initial fix: up to 4 LS iterations from nav_init_pos seed; accepts when all PR residuals small; sets $81EE path in nav_step

name: nav_ls_update
note: Applies dx = P H^T r: lat/lon via radii factors ($B5C/$B64), height, clock bias (s) -> $756C, $81A6; velocity via vel_update; mode 2 4x4, mode 3 3x3, hold time-only

name: sv_phasor_init
note: Per channel: sin/cos phasors for M (n, M0), Omega (Omegadot - We, Omega0 - We toe) and i (IDOT, i0) at tx time

name: sv_phasor_step
note: Advances the three phasors by rotation (sin/cos of rate x dt) instead of new sin/cos calls

name: sv_pos_eph
note: ICD-200 SV position: Kepler series iteration, harmonic corrections, ECEF +$C0..+$D0, velocity +$D8..+$E8, ENU +$118..+$128, sinE out

name: vel_update
note: Velocity N/E/U $8F28/$8F30/$8F20 smoothed with gain $0AE97A[$8EB8]; speed $8F40, heading $8F38 (deg)

name: pos_save_ram
note: If residuals small and > 3 SVs: copy $8ED6 (h, lat, lon) to $2598, checksum $25B0

name: pps_enable_update
note: $9D10/$2920 = PPS on per $9D0E (0 off; 2 needs a time SV $B91; 3 needs TRAIM $9D2C = 0)

name: nav_data_task
note: Per epoch: channel decode resets, bit/frame/word decode, DGPS IODE check, eph commit, PR from code, carrier smoothing, tx time, frame sync, channel nav states

name: bit_edge_adjust
note: +1/-1 ms correction when the data-bit edge wraps (19 <-> 0)

name: gps_parity
note: ICD-200 parity check of word $E6C + $5An with D30* ($E74); bit-by-bit XOR (decompiles empty)

name: pr_from_code
note: Raw pseudorange $704C + $B6n = code phase x 0.00074333 (L1 wavelength / 256); C/N filter $E38/$E3A

name: sv_tx_time_update
note: Transmit time $7062 + $B6n = ms of week $E8A x 0.001 - code range / c; wraps 604800000 ms

name: pr_carrier_smooth
note: Hatch filter on $704C with carrier (weight 1/N, N doubling to 128), range rate $706A = carrier x 1.4518e-5 (lambda / 2^14)

name: eph_decode
note: Raw ephemeris -> eph[ch] ($7A3C + $EC ch) doubles with ICD scales; derived n, sqrt(1-e^2), Omegadot - We, Omega0 - We toe, sin/cos w, A, e sqrtA

name: alm_page_store
note: Stores subframe 4/5 words into the collect buffer $81CA (SV pages 1-32, page 25 SV 51/63 at +$318); word masks $CC8, $CE9/$CEA; sets $8E3 when complete

name: special_msg_collect
note: Page 17 (SV id 55): 22 characters per channel at $247C + $18n; complete -> $757C

name: eph_word_collect
note: Subframes 1-3 words 3-10 into per-SV $82D8 + $50 x SV; mask +$4A = $FFFFFF and IODC/IODE match -> +$4E ready

name: iono_page_collect
note: Page 18 (SV id 56) words 3-5: alpha/beta into $243A + 8 x ch; done -> $2439 = 1, $2438 = ch

name: sf45_page_dispatch
note: Subframe 4/5 by SV id ($E75): 1-32, 51, 63 -> alm_page_store; 56 -> iono/UTC collect; 55 -> special message

name: utc_page_collect
note: Page 18 words 6-10: A1, A0, tot, WNt, dtLS, WNLSF, DN, dtLSF into $263C + 14 x ch; done -> $263B = 1, $263A = ch

name: how_decode
note: HOW: subframe id 1-5 -> $E71, alert/AS bits to $6FBE, TOW -> $705E; consistency +-2 sets $E7A (TOW verified)

name: chan_nav_state_update
note: Channel nav state $6FBD + $B6n: 1-4 track, 5 bit sync, 6 frame sync, 7 TOW, 8 ephemeris; loads stored eph (one per pass)

name: alm_toa_track
note: Tracks almanac toa from pages (x 4096); toa change restarts collection ($81CE = 1)

name: alm_health_decode
note: Page 25 6-bit health (table $0AEF4C maps SV to word/byte) -> flags 1 = healthy for SV 1-32

name: nav_bits_new
note: Number of new 20 ms data bits since last epoch (ms counter $2922, phase $274C)

name: eph_store_ok
note: Stored eph $8FDA + $58 x SV: checksum ok and |t - toe| < 4 h (week-aware)

name: subframe_buf_clear
note: Clears a 10-word subframe buffer (6 bytes per word)

name: nav_decode_reset
note: Resets channel data-decode struct $E36 + $5An; full reset (arg 1) also clears eph valid, collect mask, subframe buffers

name: nav_bits_shift
note: Shifts new bits from $27D6 + $2Cn into the 32-bit register $E6C + $5An

name: eph_commit
note: Copies collected 24 words to per-SV store $8FDA + $58 x SV, stamps week/time, checksum; eph_decode for each channel on that SV

name: preamble_sync
note: Scans for preamble $8B (normal $22C/inverted $DD0 in top 10 bits) plus parity; sets word 1, D29*/D30*

name: word_dispatch
note: Word 2 -> how_decode; sf1 word 3 -> week $81AE, $22F2 = 1, health -> $8FAF[SV], URA; sf1-3 -> eph_word_collect; sf4/5 -> sf45_page_dispatch

name: nav_bits_frame
note: Per channel: 30-bit word assembly, parity, data inversion, word/subframe counters $E72/$E71, completed subframe copy $6FC2 -> $7000

name: chan_meas_copy
note: Copies tracking measurements $27BC + $2Cn into $6FBC + $B6n (SV, C/N, phase, carrier with half-cycle fix)

name: frame_sync_check
note: Cross-checks TOW/word position between channels; resets channels that disagree

name: eeprom_invalidate_all
note: Writes checksum + $11111111 (invalid) for all EEPROM blocks, almanac banks, position records, UTC, iono; then rcvr_init(1)

name: eph_store_invalidate
note: Breaks checksum ($11111111 added) of stored eph for one SV or all

name: dgps_age
note: Correction age in 0.1 s: t x 10 - tcorr, wrap 6048000

name: dgps_iode_ok
note: DGPS correction IODE matches channel IODE (current $75C4 + $E x SV or previous $77D8 set)

name: dgps_clear
note: Sets diff_stale, invalidates both correction sets

name: dgps_prc
note: Pseudorange correction (m) = (PRC + RRC x age) x 0.0001 for SV/IODE

name: task_eph_commit
note: Task ($8CB): eph_commit for every SV with collection ready (+$4E)

name: chan_tables_reset
note: Clears $275C/$2760/$2764/$27BC channel tables and PPS counters $291C-$2924

name: pos_restore
note: Boot: position from RAM $2598 if checksum ok, else EEPROM record $1192/$11AE (selector $11CA), else zero and save

name: sum8
note: Byte sum of a RAM block (RAM checksums are ~sum)

name: llh_to_ecef
note: (llh, datum, xyz out, aux out): aux holds sin/cos lat/lon and radii factors at +$58/+$60

name: magvar_init
note: Geomagnetic model coefficient tables (11 x 11, from $0AF036/$0AF2DA) into $2926-$3376

name: magvar_model
note: Magnetic variation from (h km, lat deg, lon deg, decimal year)

name: geoid_height
note: Geoid separation: converts to WGS-84 (table $0AF84E) unless datum 49, 10 deg grid interpolation

name: geoid_grid_value
note: Grid value x 10 helper for geoid_height

name: geoid_grid_index
note: Lat row (0-17/18) and lon column (mod 36) of the 10 deg geoid grid

name: traim
note: T-RAIM: residual spread vs alarm limit $9D16, isolates worst SV (disables $8FAF[SV], traim_time_fix); $9D28 alarm, $9D2A error, $9D2C status

name: traim_time_fix
note: Recomputes time with SV excluded (traim_rx_time), date, traim_pps_schedule

name: traim_rx_time
note: Mean receive time excluding one channel

name: traim_pps_schedule
note: pps_schedule variant using a supplied date record

name: alm_exp
note: Expanded almanac doubles, SV n at $116A + $88 x n (n 1-32)

name: chan_use
note: Per channel 4 bytes: +0 use for position, +1 use for PR/velocity, +2 has transmit time

name: iono_delay
note: Klobuchar delay (s) per SV, double at $22F6 + 8 x SV

name: iono_page_state
note: Per-channel collect state for page 18 iono words

name: iono_page_ch
note: Channel that completed the iono page

name: iono_page_ready
note: Iono page complete; nav_task copies and saves

name: pos_saved
note: RAM copy of position (h, lat, lon), checksum $25B0

name: traim_resid
note: Copy of PR residuals per channel for TRAIM

name: utc_params
note: 14 bytes: dtLS, dtLSF, tot, WNt, WNLSF, DN, A0 (long), A1 (long)

name: utc_page_state
note: Per-channel collect state for page 18 UTC words

name: utc_page_ch
note: Channel that completed the UTC page

name: utc_offset
note: GPS-UTC (s, double), used by gps_to_date when $9D86 = 1

name: alt_hold_msl
note: Altitude hold height is MSL (add geoid $7574)

name: datum
note: dx, dy, dz, 1/f, a (doubles), datum number at +40

name: pps_hw_delay
note: 1PPS fixed delay (s, double), set by boot_time_set

name: alm_collect_restart
note: Clear word masks on next page

name: dop_used
note: DOP of the current solution (HDOP 2D, PDOP 3D)

name: cable_delay
note: Antenna cable delay (@@Az), used by pps_schedule

name: pr_pred
note: Range - c x SV clock per channel

name: pos_llh
note: Output position: height, lat, lon (doubles, rad)

name: sol_llh
note: Solution at measurement time: height, lat, lon

name: sv_deselect
note: User deselect flag per SV (index SV)

name: sv_enable
note: Per SV: 0 after unhealthy sf1 or TRAIM exclusion; all set to 1 hourly by nav_task

name: nav_h
note: Geometry rows, $20 per channel: 1, LOS.E, LOS.N, LOS.U

name: pos_aux
note: llh_to_ecef aux for the solution (radii factors $B5C, $B64)

name: sol_code
note: nav_solve_mode internal: 0 < 3 SVs, 2 DOP fail, 3 2D, 4 3D, 5 hold

name: pred_in
note: Prediction inputs: datum, local offset $C9A, position $C9C, mask $CB4, date $CB6

name: pps_mode
note: 1PPS control mode (0 off, 1 on, 2 tracking, 3 TRAIM ok)

name: traim_status
note: 0 none removed, 1 SV removed, 2 too few SVs

name: ee_pos_rec
note: EEPROM $1192/$11AE: two position records (h, lat, lon) + checksum; selector $11CA

name: new
note: Set at decode; forces phasor init

name: esqrta
note: e x sqrtA (relativistic term with F)

name: omega_ph
note: svst[ch], stride $174; phasor: +0 t, +8 rate, +$10 rate dt, +$18/+$20 sin/cos step, +$28/+$30 sin/cos, +$38 angle

name: los
note: LOS unit vector x, y, z

name: enu
note: N, E, U of SV - user

name: rec
note: Almanac buffer: record SV n at +$18 x n: +0 dataID/SVid, +1 e, +3 toa, +4 di, +6 Omegadot, +8 health, +9 sqrtA, +$C Omega0, +$F w, +$12 M0, +$15 af0/af1

name: page25
note: Two 24-byte records: sf5 page 25 (+$319 toa, +$31A week), sf4 page 25

name: nsets
note: Prediction buffer ($B14): number of SV sets

name: sv
note: SV n record at +$C0 + $24 x n: +0 valid, +2 az (deg, word), +4 el (deg, char), +6 range rate, +8 x, +$C y, +$10 z, +$14 N, +$18 E, +$1C U, +$20 range (longs, m)

name: sets
note: 10 bytes each: 8 SVs, DOP x 10 word at +8

name: toa_seen
note: Almanac toa tracking flag (+$30) and toa (+$32)

name: flags
note: Bit 0 parity fail, 3 URA >= 6, 4 unhealthy, 5/6 HOW flags

name: pr_raw
note: Raw pseudorange from code phase (m, mod 1 ms)
